# Build First Site

> Web design and development studio building high-converting business websites, e-commerce stores, and AI-powered web apps for clients in the US, UK, and Australia. Fixed-price quotes, fast delivery, full code ownership.

## About

Build First Site is a web studio founded by Aman Singh (ex-L&T Finance, 3+ years engineering at scale). We specialize in custom Next.js and React builds, e-commerce platforms, Flutter mobile apps, and AI integrations for businesses in Sydney, Melbourne, Denver, Phoenix, Nashville, and across the US, UK, and Australia.

## Services

- [Business Websites](https://buildfirstsite.com/): Multi-page sites with local SEO, contact forms, booking integration. From $2,000.
- [E-Commerce Stores](https://buildfirstsite.com/): Custom Stripe checkout, inventory, admin dashboard. From $4,000.
- [AI / SaaS MVPs](https://buildfirstsite.com/): Auth, billing, AI integrations, multi-LLM apps. From $5,000.
- [Landing Pages](https://buildfirstsite.com/): Conversion-focused single pages. From $600.
- [Monthly Retainer](https://buildfirstsite.com/): Ongoing development from $600/month.

## Technology Stack

- Frontend: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Three.js
- Backend: FastAPI, Node.js, Express, Python, REST APIs
- Mobile: Flutter, Dart, React Native
- Database: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Supabase
- AI / LLMs: OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Groq, Mistral, LangChain
- Payments & DevOps: Stripe, Vercel, AWS, Docker
